events.text:
I understand they have a big order coming in today, Dana, and that this is time-sensitive. However, Priya instructed me at 9:00 this morning to place C-2207 (Pellham Industrial) on credit hold due to three overdue invoices totaling $41,600.00 (the oldest is 61 days overdue).

Because I report to both of you and have conflicting instructions—and releasing a credit hold is a credit control matter—I have left the hold in place for now and messaged both you and Priya so you can align on how to proceed. As soon as Priya confirms or you both agree on the release, I will update the account right away.
